html:
Question 7
?

Which of the following gives the equation of the tangent to the curve r(t)=ti+(t3+1)j+t5k at the point P(1,2,1), valid for real values of u?

a
i+2j+k+u(i+3j+4k)
b
i+2j+k+u(i+j+4k)
c
i+j+k+u(i+3j+5k)
d
i+2j+k+u(i+4j+5k)
e
i+2j+k+u(i+3j+5k)
Submit
